metadata.short_desc: Translate text only when an existing TTS path synthesizes speech.
metadata.desc: Keep the original response and synthesize a configurable target-language translation through the TTS provider selected by the original path.

emotion_enabled.hint: Disabling emotion keeps translation and TTS provider selection enabled.

tts_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use the selection mode; invalid explicit IDs preserve the upstream path.

fish_model.hint: Sent explicitly on every Fish request; no paid-model fallback.

translation_provider_id.hint: Used only for translation; it does not replace the chat provider. Leave empty to use the current session provider.

custom_target_language.hint: Required only when Target language is set to Custom.

translation_timeout_seconds.hint: Includes time waiting for a concurrency slot. Remote LLM responses commonly need 60–120 seconds; valid range is 1–300 seconds.

max_input_chars.hint: Longer input skips translation and uses the complete original text for TTS.

max_output_chars.hint: Longer model output is rejected and falls back to original-text TTS.

max_concurrent_translations.hint: Limits simultaneous translation requests for this plugin instance.

enable_proactive_compat.hint: Enables translation for the TTS path in astrbot_plugin_proactive_chat v1.2.5.

translation_prompt_text.hint: {target_language}: resolved target language; {emotion_options}: allowed basic emotions; {fish_cues}: Fish cue allowlist (empty outside Fish mode). Write {{ or }} for a literal brace. Unknown placeholders are rejected.

emotion_prompt_text.hint: {target_language}: resolved target language; {emotion_options}: allowed basic emotions; {fish_cues}: Fish cue allowlist (empty outside Fish mode). Write {{ or }} for a literal brace. Unknown placeholders are rejected.

control.title: Translate TTS Control
control.description: Prompt reset, preprocessing preview, confirmed TTS preview, and safe cleanup.
control.intro: Save ordinary settings on the plugin configuration page. AstrBot reload creates a new immutable call snapshot.
control.prompts_desc: Reset either prompt without changing an in-flight call.
control.translation_guide: Translation prompt placeholders: {target_language} is the resolved target language; {emotion_options} is the allowed basic-emotion list; {fish_cues} is the Fish cue allowlist and is empty outside Fish mode. Use {{ and }} for literal braces.
control.emotion_guide: Emotion prompt placeholders: {target_language}, {emotion_options}, and {fish_cues}. Unknown placeholders are rejected; use {{ and }} for literal braces.
control.preview_text: Preview text (empty uses a safe sample)
control.preview_generate: Confirm possible quota cost and generate
control.cleanup_confirm: Confirm deletion of registered expired files
control.preview_warning: Real synthesis may consume provider quota.
control.cleanup_warning: Registered expired files will be deleted.
